## ATS Rules & Parsing Standards Implemented
-------------------------------------------
1. Single-Column Flow: No split tables or multi-column grids that scramble text extraction in Taleo or Workday.
2. Standard Header Hierarchy: Contact Information, Professional Summary, Work Experience, Education, Skills, Certifications.
3. Pure Vector PDF Text: Built using standard OpenType/TrueType system fonts (Inter, Roboto) rendered as true vector glyphs.
4. Quantifiable Metric Action Bullets: Every role template includes CAR (Challenge-Action-Result) and XYZ action formula bullets.
5. Zero Paywalls: Full features, PDF exports, and data backups are accessible without account creation or credit card entry.

## Ecosystem Integration: ZenScout AI
-------------------------------------
Portal: https://ai-job-search-agent-chi.vercel.app/
Capabilities: Multi-agent autonomous job scraper matching real-time Google Jobs with user resumes, AI cover letter generator, and live mock interview practice.
